services.CODE: chart-rank, chart-qoq, chart-longrun, chart-cum, chart-annual, chart-spread, chart-group-194160, chart-group-194270, chart-group-194310 — selects the series; the main-industry / sub-index tree is spelled out per code in compute.py
services.NAME_HE: chart-rank — display label for a code without a short label in compute.py
services.FREQ: chart-rank — rows filtered to quarterly (Q); every code here is quarterly
services.YEAR: chart-longrun, chart-qoq, chart-annual, kpi:top — the quarter axis (with PERIOD)
services.TIME_PERIOD: skip: same as YEAR + PERIOD, which compute reads
services.DATE: skip: the quarter's first day, derived from YEAR + PERIOD
services.VALUE: table:rank — the published index level on its own base, shown only next to its base
services.BASE_DESC: table:rank — base of the published level
services.PERCENT: chart-qoq, chart-rank, insight:quarter_move — published change vs the previous quarter
services.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-rank, chart-spread, kpi:top, kpi:bottom, kpi:median, kpi:up, insight:leader, insight:breadth, insight:streak, insight:spread
services.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-longrun, chart-cum, chart-annual, chart-group-194160, chart-group-194270, chart-group-194310, insight:longrun, insight:annual — rebased to 100 at a shared start quarter
services.CHAIN_BASE: chart-longrun — named in the about-the-data note (each code has its own base)
